const a: any = [1, 2];
Object.defineProperty(a, "length", { writable: false });
a[2] = 3; a.length = 0; a[0] = 7;
console.log(a, Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(a, "length"));
for (const f of [() => a.pop(), () => a.unshift(0), () => a.splice(0, 1)]) {
  try { f(); } catch (e) { console.log((e as Error).message); }
}
console.log(a);
